src/acl-state.ts.name: Napplet grants store
src/acl-state.ts.description: Holds each napplet's granted capabilities, blocks and storage allowance, saves them through the host and reports revocations.

src/enforce.ts.name: Capability gate
src/enforce.ts.description: Checks an incoming message's required capability against the sender's grants and reports each check to the host.
